answers.core:
This proposal directly affects the **core editor workflow**, similar to the **Directory Naming Convention** feature.  
The functionality also relies on existing core string conversion utilities functions for snake_case, pascalCase and CamelCase.
answers.workaround: I don't think so, this behavior is part of the editor’s internal drag-and-drop system, and overriding it through a script or plugin might be less reliable.
